lines: Seat 1 chooses Wildheart: at the end, 1 point per Wild tile held, up to 3.
Seat 2 chooses Hexer: at the end, 1 point per Scorch or Blight cast, up to 3.
Bid 2 mana on the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 0).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 0) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Shifting tile at (-1, 1) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (1, -1) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Wildheart.
Seat 2's trait is Hexer.
Seat 3's trait is Golemwright.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 3 collects 6 mana.
Build a Shrine on the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3) for 5 mana, leaving 2: the tile yields 1 more mana. It is worth 1 point at the end to whoever holds the tile.
Cast Blight for 3 mana: the Shifting tile at (-1, 1) (yields 1) yields nothing in the next round's income.
Build a Sanctum on the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) for 5 mana, leaving 5: your spells aimed at it or a tile next to it cost 1 less. It is worth 1 point at the end to whoever holds the tile.
All together: 8 mana, leaving 2.
Round 1.
Seat 3 attunes the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 1) for 10 mana.
Seat 1 builds a Shrine on (-1, 2).
Seat 2 builds a Sanctum on (-1, 0).
Seat 2 casts Blight on the Shifting tile at (-1, 1) (yields 1): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Wild tile at (0, -1) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (2, 0) (yields 3); the Wild tile at (1, 0) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3).
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 3 collects 7 mana.
